test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) to improve road safety

(B) stricter traffic rules

(C) should be implemented

(D) immediately
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **BCAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Stricter traffic rules," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "should be implemented" **(BC)** continues the logical sequence, stating what needs to be done.
 
• **The next part,** "to improve road safety," adds the purpose of implementing stricter traffic rules, indicated by (A).
 
• **Ending with **"immediately" (D) completes the sentence by emphasizing the urgency of the implementation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (CBAD):** This option starts with "should be implemented stricter traffic rules," which is grammatically incorrect and disrupts the logical flow.
 
• **Option 3 (BACD):** This option starts with "Stricter traffic rules to improve road safety should be implemented," which misplaces the urgency emphasized by "immediately."
 
• Option 4 (ABCD): This option starts with "to improve road safety" but ends with "immediately" in the wrong order.
